summary.text: Thomas Katsiantonis is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former state representative for Hillsborough 15.

paragraphs.text: Katsiantonis, who is also known as Tommy, is listed by Ballotpedia as having served in the New Hampshire House representing Hillsborough 15 in 2003-2004 and again from 2008 to 2012.
He ran again in Hillsborough 15 in 2020 and 2024 as a Democrat and did not win in either general election.
He advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary for Hillsborough 39.
